params.name: content
params.description:
Controls how much prompt content is included in the response. 'full' includes the full prompt, 'preview' includes a short prompt_preview, and 'none' omits prompt content entirely. The outline field is always included.

* `full` - full
* `preview` - preview
* `none` - none

params.name: created_by_id
params.description: Filter prompts by the ID of the user who created them.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
